content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Configure for Email-to-Case ## slug: configure-email-to-case ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) (Are you interested in this extension package?) The Configure for Email-to Case extension package is a paid add-on for Blackthorn Compliance. Please contact your Account Manager to learn more about purchasing it. ::: 1. Install the Email-to-Case Extension Package: * [production](https://login.salesforce.com/?ec=302&startURL=%2Fpackaging%2FinstallPackage.apexp%3Fp0%3D04tf4000004Tm8o%26isdtp%3Dp1){target="_blank"} * [sandbox](https://test.salesforce.com/?ec=302&startURL=%2Fpackaging%2FinstallPackage.apexp%3Fp0%3D04tf4000004Tm8o%26isdtp%3Dp1){target="_blank"} 2. Once installation is complete, Turn on Detection for EmailMessage. 3. You should receive the following notification: ![detection turned on](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/detection%20turned%20on.png){height="" width=""} 4. Congratulations! You have successfully configured Email Messages for Blackthorn Compliance. :::(Warning) () You still need to install Compliance from the Blackthorn {{variable.Link_CandyShop}}, but we will upgrade your existing package to include Email-to-Case support. :::
